title: Home-screen notification test — 2.15.5
items: Adds a clearly labelled, once-only test notice: Projector Guy app has a new update — Test notification.
Appears only on Home after installing and activating this version, with background alerts enabled. Waits while another app is open and disappears automatically.
The test expires after 30 November 2026. Installing the update or seeing the notification does not install any streaming app.

title: Updates on your Home screen — 2.15.4
items: Compact update banner with logos for installed streaming apps and Projector Guy features. Only compatible apps with a newer library version are included.
Alerts wait while another app is open, appear on the stock launcher, and disappear when you leave Home. Your remote stays with the launcher.
Checks run about every six hours when connected and are scheduled again after reboot. Already shown app versions are remembered to avoid repeat alerts.

Background alerts default on after activation and can be turned off in Preferences. Automatic launcher-alert setup was verified on the A5 Pro; Android permission setup remains available where required. No app is installed by the notification.

title: Live readings and a clearer Clean tool — 2.15.3
items: RAM and free-storage readings now refresh every two seconds while Clean is open, including during cleanup. Fresh readings are taken after completion.
RAM cleanup and temporary-file cleanup now show measured progress as apps and files are checked, followed by the final results scan.
The Tools cleanup tile is now called Clean, with teal broom artwork. Tools cards align along the same top edge.

title: A5 cleanup tools and smoother setup — 2.15.2
items: New A5 Tools → RAM & storage: live available RAM, free storage, safe background-app cleanup and a review screen for completed installer files or inactive-app cache. App logins and settings are kept.
Optional Close background apps on exit switch in Optimise A5 Pro and setup. Runs when you exit Projector Guy with Back; saved across reboots and off by default.
First-time setup starts after login and A5 projector selection. Completed setup stays completed; other projector models skip the A5 setup.
Factory menus is now available only in Hidden Features. LinkDrop is in Entertainment → Tools.

title: Factory menus, simpler settings and LinkDrop — 2.15.1
items: Factory menus is now in Tools, replacing the older factory-menu entry. Automatic English labels and the original-language switch remain available.
Picture and sound controls are combined into Picture & Sound Settings. The separate English menus sidebar shortcut has been removed.
LinkDrop updated to the official single APK 1.0.38, version code 39. Installation and launch tested on the A5 Pro; Karl confirmed it works.

title: Automatic English menus and network speed — 2.15.0
items: Supported Newlink factory menus now get offline English labels automatically after app activation or first opening. Customers do not need to turn on the English switch on compatible units with the projector connection available.

Known labels are translated while the manufacturer controls, focus values and existing accessibility services stay intact. The overlay disappears outside supported menus. Unknown labels remain unchanged; original Chinese can be selected in English menus.

If Android requires a one-time accessibility/debugging approval, the English menus screen explains how to finish permission setup. Translation does not run motor tests, calibration or repair procedures.
New Network speed tool: download Mbps, HTTPS latency, jitter, Stop and a saved last result. A test downloads up to 50 MB from Cloudflare; streaming guidance is an estimate, not a playback guarantee.

The signed build was tested on A5 Pro: automatic English activation, menu navigation, preserved values, overlay exit and manual OFF; network measurement, Stop and saved-result reopening were also tested.

title: A smoother first-time A5 setup — 2.13.1
items: Choose streaming and Live TV apps in one place, then select your A5 improvements before setup starts.
Selected app installs and projector optimisation now run together, with progress from the real native jobs and a brew break message.
Saved choices support resuming interrupted setup. Apps already installed at the current or a newer version are kept. Failed apps can be retried or left for later without removing existing logins.
Slow native connections cannot replay the previous install result while optimisation starts.
Renamed the sound switch to Remove annoying navigation sounds in setup and Optimise A5 Pro.
New personalised Cinema finish screen with corrected apostrophes and emojis. Entertainment retains its access-code lock; exploring later returns Home.
Release build, signature and browser integration checks passed. This revision has not been freshly tested on a projector.

title: NOW TV — newer single-file A5 download
items: Replaced the old NOW TV 5.0.0 download with NOW 7.11.200 as one complete APK for A5 Pro.
The exact single APK installed and reached the sign-in screen on the A5 Pro. Playback and account sign-in have not been tested.
Replacing a differently signed existing NOW app may require uninstalling it first, which clears its login/settings.

title: A5 setup compatibility fix — 2.12.1
items: Auto-hide no longer stops setup when the built-in touchscreen is inactive. The controls hide and the helper waits for a touch device to become available.
The helper is copied in small, verified chunks to stay within the projector connection limit.
Optimisation progress now moves forward consistently between saving preferences and preparing apps.

title: A5 first-time setup — Projector Guy 2.12.0
items: New A5 customers can check installed apps, choose streaming and Live TV apps, then install or update them one by one. Existing and newer apps are retained; signature conflicts are left for attention without removing logins.
Finish with your choice of A5 speed, navigation sounds, gaming preference and touchscreen auto-hide settings. The storage check now reads Android free space directly and keeps a 400 MiB reserve.
Setup completion is remembered. Reopening takes you to Home. Existing customers keep their login and go to Home after this update.
Added the personalised Entertainment end card, corrected emoji/apostrophe encoding and added the brew message while apps install.
A5 setup requires a one-time local debugging approval where Android asks. Other projector models keep their existing flow.
Corrected NOW TV package/version metadata to match the existing APK so installed-app checks can identify it correctly.

title: STV Player — one-file download
items: STV Player 1.8.14.2 now downloads as one complete APK for A5 Pro and 360, replacing the split-package download.
The exact single APK installed, signed in and played a programme on the A5 Pro. The 360 uses the same ARMv7 file; a new 360 playback test has not been performed.
If Android reports a signature conflict, uninstall the existing STV Player before installing this copy. This clears the STV login and settings.

title: Wider A5 Pro Optimise popup — 2.11.13
items: The Optimise A5 Pro popup now scales to 74% of the landscape screen width, giving labels and switches more space.
Existing optimisation preferences are retained. The welcome shortcut is labelled Optimise my projector.

title: A5 Pro touchscreen auto-hide — 2.11.12
items: Added Auto-hide touchscreen controls to Optimise A5 Pro. Touch the built-in screen to show the controls; they hide after five seconds without touch.
OFF restores the original control visibility. The ON preference is saved and restores after Android completes its startup broadcasts.
Tested on the A5 Pro, including physical touch, switching OFF and restarting. Requires supported factory-rooted A5 Pro firmware and locally authorised ADB.

title: Faster TellyGrid download for A5 Pro and 360
items: Replaced both A5 Pro and 360 TellyGrid downloads with the same non-debug PG1 APK.

Alternating cold-start tests on the A5 measured about 2.6 seconds for the optimised copy and 4.0–4.2 seconds for the original alpha. This measures Android activity launch, not complete programme-data loading.

The optimised copy has a separate package identity and installs alongside the earlier official copy. A5 Pro launch testing passed; the identical 360 download is published at Karl’s request with on-device 360 testing pending.

title: Faster A5 Pro Home and app optimisation — 2.11.11
items: Improve projector speed now includes a direct stock-launcher Home route on supported rooted A5 Pro firmware, menu animation settings and Android app compilation.
A progress bar shows compilation progress. The completed state is saved and survives reboot. Switching Off restores the saved Home route and animation settings; compiled app code is retained.
Remove navigation sounds now uses ON to silence clicks and OFF to restore them.
Renamed the gaming control Activate gaming mode 🎮. It controls Android’s Allow game mode permission; active low-latency processing remains unverified.
The completion popup button now reads Mate... I know.

title: A5 Pro optimisation controls — 2.11.10
items: Added Optimise A5 Pro below Sound Settings for supported A5 Pro devices.
Remote-friendly on/off pills control navigation sounds, animation performance and Android’s Allow game mode setting.
Navigation sounds use the manufacturer’s persistent key-sound control. Performance Off restores the animation values saved before switching it on.
Gaming mode controls Android’s permission for low-latency requests. Active processing bypass and lower input latency have not been verified.

title: One-time app activation — version 2.11.3
items: Removed the 30-day activation expiry. Once activated, the app stays activated on that installation.
Existing saved activations are retained, including activations whose old 30-day session has expired.
Version 2.11.3 disables app-data backup so activation data is not backed up for a reinstall. Clearing app data or reinstalling requires a PIN again.

title: ITVX single-APK installer fixed
items: ITVX 17.20 now downloads as one compatibility APK, replacing the split package that failed in the A5 installer.
Download/install code, picture, sound and remote controls tested on A5 Pro and XBJ 360. Manual sign-in is required.
Uninstall older ITVX builds before installing if Android reports a signature conflict. This clears ITVX login/settings.

title: Disney+, ITVX and TV guide updates
items: Disney+ 26.20 and ITVX 17.20: picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro and XBJ 360. Manual sign-in is supported; scan-to-login is not available in these tested flows.
TellyGrid updated to 0.8.2-alpha.8.2 for A5 Pro and 360; launches on both. Stock launchers retained.
Disney+ A5 downloads as one merged compatibility APK. Disney+ 360 and ITVX use original signed package sets. ITVX requires removing the older differently signed version, clearing its login/settings.
Fixed model-specific package selection when two projector variants share the same tile name.

title: BBC iPlayer download now installs Beeb
items: The BBC iPlayer tile now downloads Beeb 0.1.6, an independent open-source BBC player not affiliated with or endorsed by the BBC. The catalogue tile keeps its existing name and icon; the installed app is named Beeb.
Live picture, sound and remote controls tested on A5 Pro and XBJ 360. On-demand playback has not yet been verified. Other projector models are untested.
Downloads as one APK, with a separate compatibility build for the 360. Your existing BBC iPlayer installation and login are retained.

title: YouTube single-APK download fixed
items: YouTube 5.30.304 now downloads as one original Google-signed APK, replacing the split package. No merged or re-signed YouTube build is used.
Sign-in and playback tested on A5 Pro and XBJ 360.
If a newer YouTube version is installed, Android may require uninstalling it before installing this compatibility build. This clears app settings and may require signing in again.

title: Channel 4 TV app available for all projector selections
items: The single-file Channel 4 Android TV app is now available in Live TV for every projector selection. Requires Android 8 or later.
Picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro and XBJ 360. Other models have not been tested.
Uninstall an older Channel 4 build if Android reports a signature conflict, then install this APK and sign in again.

title: Channel 4 TV app for A5 Pro
items: Channel 4 now uses the Android TV interface on A5 Pro, replacing the mobile build that showed a Google Play services warning.
Downloads as one APK. Sign-in, picture, sound and remote navigation tested on A5 Pro.
Uninstall the previous Channel 4 app before installing this version, then sign in again. HDMI/capture playback compatibility has not been verified.

title: Projector Guy 2.11.2 — installer update
items: Added a Projector install option when Android cannot install an app’s split APK files. Tested with the original Google-signed YouTube on A5 Pro.
The fallback requires debugging enabled and one-time approval of Projector Guy’s connection. Existing app data is kept.
Downloads now show one overall progress percentage, and failed installs retain their files for retry.

title: Live TV guide added
items: TellyGrid Live TV Guide is now available in the Live TV section, alongside BBC iPlayer, Channel 4 and My5.

title: Original A5 Pro YouTube restored
items: YouTube now offers the original A5 Pro 5.30.304 build, with Google’s original signature.
This replaces the newer 360 build in the catalogue.

title: Disney+ installation update
items: Disney+ 26.19 now downloads as one APK, replacing the split installer that failed on the A5 Pro.
If Android reports a signature conflict, uninstall your existing Disney+ first and install again. You will need to sign in again.

title: Disney+, Netflix and STV updates
items: Disney+ updated to 26.19.0 — picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro. Requires Android 12L or later.
Netflix 9.88.0 build 7 is now available for A5 Pro.
STV Player updated to TV build 1.8.14.2 — picture, sound and remote navigation confirmed on A5 Pro. Requires Android 12L or later.
Disney+ and STV may require uninstalling your existing version first, then signing in again.

title: XBJ Remote Control added
items: New Remote Control page — control your XBJ projector from the Projector Guy app
Full D-pad navigation with power, menu, and OK buttons
Quick-access hotkeys for Netflix, YouTube, Hulu and Disney+
Volume and focus controls, plus playback buttons
Automatic projector discovery on your local network
Works with the native Projector Guy app — just tap Remote in the sidebar

title: Split APK support & new streaming apps
items: Added ITV Mobile Player 17.17.0 with full split APK support — now installs smoothly on all devices
Updated STV Player 4.43.0.1 with split APK support for better compatibility
Updated BBC iPlayer to Nvidia Shield Partners version with new official BBC iPlayer logo
Added automatic split APK handling in the store — download and install multiple APK files in one go

title: New TV-style app store design
items: Redesigned the whole store into a TV-style layout — a side menu plus big poster-style cards, instead of the old top-tab layout
Added AK47 Sports, MovieBox and HD Streamz to Entertainment
Added a "Change Projector" option in the sidebar to quickly switch models without digging into Preferences
Entertainment now stays unlocked for 30 minutes after entering the code, instead of just 2
The Entertainment lock icon now shows amber while locked and turns green and open the moment it's unlocked, everywhere it appears
Fixed the sign-in screen so the on-screen keyboard no longer covers the username/code fields

title: Generate your own Entertainment code
items: The Entertainment unlock screen now has a "Generate my code" button — get instant access without messaging us, no need to wait for a reply
Self-generated codes are valid for 60 seconds, so they can't be shared around after the fact

title: Install all Live TV apps in one go
items: The Live TV section now has an "Install all" button — installs BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4 and My5 one after another instead of finding and installing each one yourself

title: New app added and updates
items: Added STV Player to Live TV
Added LinkDrop to Tools in Entertainment
Updated Channel 4 to the latest version
Fixed an issue where MovieBox could fail to install on some projectors
